Built a 2D spine-beam OpenSees model of the four-span (30+40+40+30 m) cast-in-place continuous prestressed concrete box girder, modelled as continuous on piers (Pier 1/2/3 columns, D=1.6 m twin columns, C40, fixed at base, heights 25/28/6 m).

- Idealization: spine_beam_2d; system: continuous_on_piers.

- Lane load (JTG D60-2015): 4 design lanes, ξ = 0.67, qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 320/340/340/320 kN per span.
- f1 = 3.139 Hz, impact factor μ = 0.1864 (JTG D60-4.3.2).

Model ran successfully; self-weight reactions ≈ 2.44–9.12 MN per support line, max lane positive moment 11.32 MN·m (mid-span 2) and max negative 8.97 MN·m at support 2. L1/L2/L3 checks passed.
